duas.title: The Greatest Du'ā of Tawheed:
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ
duas.english: There is no god worthy of worship except Allāh.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ said this is the best remembrance. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 3435)

duas.title: Du'ā for Firmness in Faith:
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Changer of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
duas.reference: Reported by Umm Salamah, the Prophet ﷺ recited this often. (Jāmi' at-Tirmidhī 3522 - Ṣaḥīḥ)

duas.title: Du'ā for Guidance to Truth:
duas.arabic: اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
duas.english: Guide me to the truth in matters where people differ.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ taught this du'ā. (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 770)

duas.title: Du'ā for Firmness in Īmān & Islam
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ said this often. (Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī 3522 - Ḥasan)

duas.title: Du'ā upon Hearing Good News (Affirming al-Qadar)
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.english: All praise is for Allāh, by whose favour good deeds are completed.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ taught this when something pleased him. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Al-Adab al-Mufrad 783)

duas.title: Du'ā for Protection from Punishment in the Grave (Belief in the Hereafter)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.english: O Allāh, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.
duas.reference: Reference: The Prophet ﷺ taught this in multiple aḥādīth. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6365)

duas.title: For Steadfastness in Shahādah
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.english: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
duas.reference: (Ibrāhīm 14:40)

duas.title: Upon Completing Ṣalāh
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.english: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You in the best manner.
duas.reference: (Sunan Abī Dāwūd 1522 - Ḥasan)

duas.title: For Acceptance of Worship
duas.arabic: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَمِنكُمْ
duas.english: May Allah accept [this worship] from us and from you.
duas.reference: (Commonly said during Eid, based on the practice of the Companions)

duas.title: Du'ā Before Recitation
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shayṭān.
duas.reference: Commanded by Allah: "So when you recite the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Shayṭān, the expelled." (An-Naḥl 16:98)

duas.title: Du'ā for Understanding & Benefit
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
duas.english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me that which will benefit me.
duas.reference: Reported from the Prophet ﷺ as a comprehensive knowledge du'ā. (Sunan Ibn Mājah 251)

duas.title: Du'ā Upon Hearing an Āyah about Mercy or Punishment
duas.arabic: يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنَ العَذَابِ وَيَسْأَلُ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ
duas.english: He would seek refuge from the punishment and ask for the mercy.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ would do this during recitation. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6347)

duas.title: Du'a of Seeking Intercession
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَشَفِّعْهُ فِيَّ
duas.english: O Allah, accept his intercession for me.
duas.reference: Part of the supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ to the blind man. (Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3578)

duas.title: Du'a When Hearing the Adhan
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means and the virtue, and raise him to the praised station that You promised him.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ said whoever says this will earn his intercession. (Sahih al-Bukhari 614)

duas.title: General Salat upon the Prophet ﷺ
duas.arabic: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
duas.english: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him.
duas.reference: The minimal form fulfilling the command to send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ. (Al-Ahzab 33:56)

duas.title: Duʿāʾ of Seeking Intercession
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ شَفِّعْ فِيَّ مُحَمَّدًا
duas.english: O Allah, allow Muhammad to intercede for me.
duas.reference: Part of a longer duʿāʾ taught by the Prophet ﷺ for the Day of Judgment. (Musnad Aḥmad 13964 - Ṣaḥīḥ)

duas.title: Duʿāʾ When Hearing the Call to Prayer (Adhān)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means [of intercession] and superiority, and raise him to the praised station that You promised him.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ said whoever says this will earn his intercession. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 614)

duas.title: General Ṣalāh upon the Prophet ﷺ
duas.arabic: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
duas.english: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him.
duas.reference: The minimal form complying with the divine command in Sūrah Al-Aḥzāb 33:56.

duas.title: Most Comprehensive Duʿāʾ
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.english: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.reference: Qur'an 2:201. The Prophet ﷺ said it was the most frequent duʿāʾ he made. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6389)

duas.title: Duʿāʾ for All Needs
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ taught this and said to ask Allah for al-ʿĀfiyah, for nothing better is given after certainty of faith. (Sunan Ibn Mājah 3871 - Ṣaḥīḥ)

duas.title: Powerful Morning/Evening Dhikr (3 times)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose Name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.reference: Whoever says this three times in the morning and evening will not be harmed by anything. (Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5088 - Ṣaḥīḥ)

duas.title: For a Sound Heart
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا، وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا، أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا
duas.english: O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it, for You are the best to purify it. You are its Guardian and Master.
duas.reference: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2722

duas.title: Against Envy & Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.reference: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 2708

duas.title: For Protection from Hypocrisy
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, evil actions, and evil desires.
duas.reference: Sunan at-Tirmidhī 3591 – Ḥasan

duas.title: For Excellent Character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
duas.english: O Allah, as You have made my appearance beautiful, make my character beautiful.
duas.reference: Musnad Aḥmad 12330 – Ḥasan

duas.title: When Entering a Home
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for the best of entry and the best of exit. In Allah's name we enter and in Allah's name we exit, and in Allah our Lord we place our trust.
duas.reference: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5096 – Ṣaḥīḥ

duas.title: For Protection from Bad Character
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, evil actions, and evil desires.
duas.reference: Sunan at-Tirmidhī 3591 – Ḥasan

duas.title: For Provision of Halal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا رِزْقًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاسِعًا
duas.english: O Allah, provide us with lawful, good, and abundant provision.
duas.reference: Based on the general duʿāʾ for good provision in Sunan Ibn Mājah 3833.

duas.title: When Forgetting to Say Bismillāh Before Eating
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
duas.english: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ taught this when he forgot to begin with Bismillāh. (Sunan Abī Dāwūd 3767 – Ṣaḥīḥ)

duas.title: For Protection from Haram Earnings
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness, old age, sin, and debt.
duas.reference: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6367 (Debt often leads to Haram means).

duas.title: For a Righteous Spouse & Offspring
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
duas.reference: Qur'an, Al-Furqān 25:74.

duas.title: For Protection of Family
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.
duas.reference: Sunan Abī Dāwūd 5074 – Ṣaḥīḥ.

duas.title: For Marital Harmony
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا
duas.english: O Allah, bring our hearts together and reconcile between us.
duas.reference: Inspired by the general duʿāʾ for reconciliation in Qur'an (Al-Anfāl 8:63) and Prophetic practice.

duas.title: For Unity & Forgiveness Within the Ummah
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
duas.reference: Qur'an, Al-Ḥashr 59:10.

duas.title: For Protection from Trials Affecting the Community
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death.
duas.reference: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 6368.

duas.title: When Seeing a Muslim Brother/Sister After Time
duas.arabic: أَحْيَاكَ اللَّهُ وَأَحْيَانَا
duas.english: May Allah give you life and give us life.
duas.reference: Al-Adab al-Mufrad.

duas.title: For Steadfastness and Guidance
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Turner of hearts, make my heart steadfast upon Your religion.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ recited this frequently. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3522 - Hasan)

duas.title: For Beneficial Knowledge and Growth
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
duas.reference: Reported from the Prophet ﷺ as a comprehensive du'a for knowledge. (Sunan Ibn Majah 251)

duas.title: For a Good Ending (Husn al-Khatimah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ عُمْرِي آخِرَهُ وَخَيْرَ عَمَلِي خَوَاتِمَهُ وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ
duas.english: O Allah, make the best of my life its end, the best of my deeds their concluding ones, and the best of my days the day I meet You.
duas.reference: Authentic du'a from the Sunnah. (Al-Sahihah 1847)

duas.title: For Protection from the Punishment of the Grave
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hellfire, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 588.

duas.title: When Visiting Graveyards
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.english: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the graves, from among the believers and Muslims. Indeed, we will, if Allah wills, join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
duas.reference: Sahih Muslim 975.

duas.title: For a Good Ending (Husn al-Khatimah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اخْتِمْ لَنَا بِحُسْنِ الْخَاتِمَةِ، وَلَا تَخْتِمْ عَلَيْنَا بِسُوءِ الْخَاتِمَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, seal our lives with a good ending, and do not seal our lives with an evil ending.
duas.reference: Quran Al Imran 3:8; Sahih al-Bukhari 6607.

duas.title: For Paradise & Protection from Hell
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.english: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.reference: Quran Al-Baqarah 2:201.

duas.title: For the Highest Level of Paradise
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings me closer to it in speech or action. And I seek refuge in You from Hell and whatever brings me closer to it in speech or action.
duas.reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 3846 – Sahih.

duas.title: When Fearing One's Sins
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي فِي الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْحَقِّ، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.english: O Allah, make me uphold the truth in this world and the Hereafter, and make me among the people of happiness in this world and the Hereafter.
duas.reference: Based on the Prophet's teaching to seek guidance in both worlds.
